name: agenting
description: Subagents let one session use several model tiers at once. This plugin makes that deliberate: a PreToolUse gate blocks any Workflow whose agent() calls have no model/effort, then asks you to approve the routing plan — offering cheaper AND higher-quality directions, not just cheaper. Also tracks a per-project routing memory (manual/semi-auto/auto mode, learned precedents in agenting/AGENTING.md) plus a mid-session cache-cost tripwire and a tokenomics measurement script. Ships 20 tiered agent definitions and an end-to-end health check.
